methods.label: Use vertex form and the negative intercept
methods.explanation:
The given vertex suggests writing the parabola in vertex form. Expanding also reveals its coefficients:
\[
\begin{aligned}
y&=a(x-4)^2-5\\
&=ax^2-8ax+(16a-5).
\end{aligned}
\]
Thus \(b=-8a\) and \(c=16a-5\).

Because this is a parabola, \(a\ne0\). If \(a<0\), then \(a(x-4)^2-5\le-5\) for every real \(x\), so there would be no \(x\)-intercepts. Hence \(a>0\), which immediately gives \(b=-8a<0\).

Let \(r<0\) be the negative intercept. Then \(r-4<-4\), so \((r-4)^2>16\). Since \(a>0\),
\[
0=a(r-4)^2-5>16a-5=c.
\]
Therefore \(c<0\) as well. Only \(a\) is positive, choice A.
